body:
I had a similar exp.  I took 12 capsules before going to work-- The most I had ever taken up till that point.  I became extremely shaky at work, and then started seeing black spots in my vision.  Afterwards I 'blacked out', though I was still conscious.  About an hour and a half went by that I could not immediately recall.  One co-worker said she was worried about me because I didnt seem to be doing any work, and I wasn't really responding to her, even though I was conscious.
